posts.author: HB
posts.body:
I recently started with gamemaker so I don't know much about the game. I want to add a partymember halfway through the game, but I don't know how to.
I know that you have to have a actor in the database, and are supposed to add him using an event. But then he's still visible in the beginning.
I have looked everywhere on google but everyone else who asked this question somehow knows how to make the member invisble in the beginning, but not how to add him later on.
Can anyone help me? (Sorry for bad English)

posts.author: Balako
posts.body:
go to database (F9) then to System, on the top left you can change the party members that appear when you start the game.
to add a member later on make an event, on the first page under PARTY tab, find change party member and change that to get whatever party member you want

posts.body: Thank you! I didn't know it was so simple xD
